text:
Brady Tkachuk spent eight seasons in Ottawa, five as captain, and is now a Florida Panther beside his brother Matthew. The fit has been immediate: 24 points in 23 games, 11 goals, and a share of the night his father Keith went into the Blues' Hall of Fame, when Brady had a goal and an assist as the brothers led a 4-1 win in St. Louis.

The way he plays has not changed. He has 97 hits, generates 1.67 expected goals per 60 (the quality of his chances, per hour of play), and Florida takes 58.6% of shot attempts at 5v5 with him on. His goals match his chances almost exactly, so this is no hot streak.

The interesting number is power play production: 15 of his 24 points have come with the extra man, on just 16.6 minutes a night. He is producing more per minute than he did in Ottawa last season. He ranks ninth of 547 skaters in wins added by his goals. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flagged a signature worth watching: 19% of his setups come from behind the net, more than twice the typical forward.
headline: Brady Tkachuk, Panther
